run_finetune_gradio_app: run the F5-TTS finetune Gradio web UI app on a specified port and host with optional sharing and API access
start_f5_tts_training: start training an F5-TTS model with specified dataset, hyperparameters, batch size, epochs, and tokenizer settings
prune_f5_tts_checkpoint: prune an F5-TTS checkpoint file to remove optimizer state and reduce model size for inference or finetuning
extend_f5_tts_vocabulary: extend an F5-TTS model vocabulary with new symbols and create a new expanded checkpoint for new language support
generate_f5_tts_inference: generate speech from text using an F5-TTS model with reference audio, inference steps, speed, and seed settings
